tasks.spec: Role: PE-CC-DEV operations forensic reviewer. Read ../../../inputs/pec75-local-forensics.md, ../../../inputs/pec75-fencing-result.md, and both preflight plans. Decide whether the durable fenced state and exact semantic job delta permit PEC-75 closure with permanent exceptions, or whether it remains blocked. Own only review.md. No network/system access. Required headings: Verdict, Proven, Violated, Unprovable, Risk Decision, Next Gate. Verdict must be PASS_WITH_EXCEPTIONS, BLOCKED, or FAIL. The checker is verdict-neutral; preserve your independent decision. Never propose mutation merely to recreate evidence.
tasks.verified: The review distinguishes recovered facts, confirmed violations, unprovable history, and the required human risk decision.
